summary: community.general breaking changes in Ansible 11: ansible-core 2.13/2.14 are no longer supported, cmd_runner args from module params get no default formatter, irc use_tls and validate_certs default to true, and rhsm_repository present/absent are removed in favor of enabled/disabled.
questions: What states should I use with rhsm_repository now?
Why does the irc module now require TLS?

answer_card.title: community.general breaking changes in Ansible 11
answer_card.answer_md:
- No longer supports ansible-core 2.13 and 2.14.
- `rhsm_repository`: `present`/`absent` are removed. Use `enabled`/`disabled`.
- `irc`: `use_tls` and `validate_certs` now default to `true`.
- `cmd_runner`: args built from module params no longer get a default formatter.
